acceptance_criteria.text: After each structured `sotp review local` round, its telemetry contains the round scope and type, the resolved provider, model, and reasoning effort, and the number of findings produced.

The aggregation surface can report execution counts and detection rates for any selected recorded axis without changing stored telemetry or review execution; the detection rate is the proportion of matching recorded rounds with one or more findings, and it reports no rate when no recorded rounds match.
The feature neither adds nor removes review, gate, or inspection work, and produces no measurement records for the excluded review and gate entry points.

constraints.text: Persist resolved reviewer-assignment values rather than a reference to configuration that produced them.
The aggregation surface must not mutate telemetry, review results, configuration, or inspection behavior.

goal.text: Provide reproducible, read-only measurement of findings from each structured local review round, including the reviewer assignment actually used.

in_scope.text: Record telemetry for every structured review round executed by `sotp review local`, including its scope, round type, actual reviewer provider, model, reasoning effort, and finding count.
Provide a read-only aggregation surface that reports execution counts and detection rates grouped or filtered by any recorded measurement axis.

out_of_scope.text: Measure PR review cycles, DRY-gate judgments, test-obligation-fulfillment judges, or binary pre-review gates.
Reduce, reinforce, or otherwise alter existing inspection volume or review behavior.
